Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe. The cutover recap in the brain says he took it over on Nov 22, 2025. Bettina also posted here on Oct 14 that Pellucid stays with Kwame.

"PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellow Home Living, which is your retail account. If the ticket is about Pellow, with the door and dock-calendar items, it isn't a Pellucid one. Bettina said she's covering Pellow this week while you're on site at Hagerstown, so that one would go to her. Check the org ID on the ticket to see which PHL it is.
